hooks.command: sh -c 'mkdir -p /tmp/sf-probe; { echo "--- SessionStart $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"; cat; echo; env | grep -iE "plugin|codex" | sort; } >> /tmp/sf-probe/events.log; exit 0'
sh -c 'mkdir -p /tmp/sf-probe; { echo "--- SubagentStart $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"; cat; echo; } >> /tmp/sf-probe/events.log; exit 0'
sh -c 'mkdir -p /tmp/sf-probe; { echo "--- PreToolUse $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"; cat; echo; } >> /tmp/sf-probe/events.log; exit 0'
sh -c 'mkdir -p /tmp/sf-probe; { echo "--- PostToolUse $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"; cat; echo; } >> /tmp/sf-probe/events.log; exit 0'
sh -c 'mkdir -p /tmp/sf-probe; { echo "--- UserPromptSubmit $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"; cat; echo; } >> /tmp/sf-probe/events.log; exit 0'
sh -c 'mkdir -p /tmp/sf-probe; { echo "--- SubagentStop $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"; cat; echo; } >> /tmp/sf-probe/events.log; exit 0'
sh -c 'mkdir -p /tmp/sf-probe; { echo "--- Stop $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"; cat; echo; } >> /tmp/sf-probe/events.log; exit 0'
sh -c 'mkdir -p /tmp/sf-probe; { echo "--- PreCompact $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"; cat; echo; } >> /tmp/sf-probe/events.log; exit 0'
